svg.title: One season day by day: Agri-JAX over DSSAT-CSM 4.8.6
svg.desc: Daily LAI, above-ground biomass, grain mass and profile soil water of UFGA8201_t04 from Agri-JAX and from DSSAT-CSM, overlaid, with the difference below each panel.
svg.text: One season day by day: Agri-JAX over DSSAT-CSM 4.8.6
UFGA8201_t04, nitrogen off. Harvest grain yield 11 859.3 kg ha⁻¹ against 11 859 kg ha⁻¹ in DSSAT.
Above-ground biomass and grain mass (kg ha⁻¹)
Δ = Agri-JAX minus DSSAT. DSSAT prints LAI to 0.01, biomass and grain mass to 1 kg ha⁻¹ and soil water to 1 mm, so
differences of that size are the rounding of its output files. DSSAT is drawn wide, Agri-JAX thin on top. Treatment 4 of
UFGA8201 (irrigated, high nitrogen), one of the 65 runs.
